summary: SSH.NET is the package ID; Renci.SshNet is only the namespace -- a PackageReference to Renci.SshNet fails restore with NU1102 (only the deprecated 1.0.0 ghost remains). The active package is SSH.NET (drieseng/SSH.NET team, 2025.1.0 stable, 279M downloads), and using Renci.SshNet remains the correct using-statement after referencing it.
evidence: dotnet restore NU1102 -> dotnet package search Renci.SshNet returns SSH.NET as the canonical -> csproj retargeted -> build clean

summary: Renci.SshNet's SshClient.CreateCommand() opens a stripped non-interactive bash that does NOT source .bashrc/.profile, so vyatta op-mode 'show' wrappers are off PATH and a bare 'show dhcp leases' returns empty silently (no error, just no body rows). Fix: invoke /opt/vyatta/bin/vyatta-op-cmd-wrapper directly with the op-mode subcommand; this wrapper handles vyatta env init internally. Belt-and-braces: ISC-format /var/run/dhcpd.leases parser as fallback when wrapper output is still empty or unparseable by the regex.
evidence: DM1 2026-06-03 18:11 live-router screenshot showed Devices DataGrid populated with Name+MAC but Last DHCP+IP columns blank; DM7 RouterClient.cs retargets GetDhcpLeasesAsync to wrapper path and adds ParseIscLeases as fallback
